## Stabilizing a recovered fragment
Lantern Court has one fixed housing with sockets S1/S2/S3.

For each fragment:
1. Fit the actual sliver into its matching socket — **Action**.
2. Close the shutter — **Action**.
3. Turn the crank and maintain the stabilization for **10 uninterrupted elapsed minutes**.

The 10-minute interval is observation/stabilization, not Transition-eligible work. Interruption restarts that 10-minute interval but does not recreate or remove the installed fragment.

A fragment completing stabilization **exactly at E** counts as sealed before the deadline.
playerExactEdits.replacement:
## Stabilizing recovered fragments

Fit each actual fragment to its matching socket, one Action per fragment. After all fragments intended for this cycle are installed, close the single shutter once with one Action. Then one worker actively turns the crank for 10 uninterrupted active minutes. The worker must remain able to perform that cranking work; interruption stops the active work and the full 10-minute crank interval must begin again, while already installed fragments remain installed. This is a fixed observation/stabilization interval, not crafting or casting, so Transition does not halve it. No check. At completion every actual fragment installed before the shutter was closed becomes inert sealed salvage at the same completion timestamp. From an empty bench, one fragment requires 612 seconds total (6 fit + 6 shutter + 600 crank), two require 618 seconds, and three require 624 seconds. No fragment can be added through the closed shutter during the running cycle.

Housing accepts 1–3 fragments. One completed crank cycle seals every fragment installed for that cycle. A later recovered fragment is a later addition: open/access the housing as physically required, fit that actual fragment with its own Action, close the shutter once, and perform a new full 10-minute active crank cycle. A prior completed cycle does not seal a later addition retroactively. Installed but unfinished fragments are not sealed at the deadline. Removing an inert sealed fragment is actual 10-minute tool work with the real wrench or other lawful tool access and does not reactivate that fragment or the site mechanism.

A fragment completing stabilization **exactly at E** counts as sealed before the deadline.

## Complete vessel operating reference

These procedures use the actual crew, anatomy, inventory, geometry and support state; they do not grant abilities or stock.

### Hull, rooms and access

NEW dry hull and fixed machinery:30x20x15ft,3000lb,AC15,120HP. Dry mass includes empty fuel tank, fixed canopy mechanism, pilot/engine stations, pressure-control hardware and the two-door airlock; it excludes installed fuel, air cartridge, loose mission stock, occupants and their equipment. Main cabin20x15x12ft; airlock10x10x12ft fits inside the stated hull envelope and has two10ft-wide12ft-high doors. Stations each have one5ft operator position; the operator uses that same square, not a second square. Two underfloor5x5x2ft lockers hold the actual loose kit; check actual cargo volume and access. Nothing overlaps occupied bodies or solid fittings. In the berth map, the hull isx0–20,y0–30. Main cabin isx0–20,y0–15; airlock isx10–20,y15–25, so the two enclosed rooms do not overlap. The inner door lies aty15,x10–20; the outer door lies atx20,y15–25. The two5ft station positions lie atx0–5,y0–5 andx15–20,y0–5. The sample worker starts beside the inner door at(12.5,12.5), uses a legal airlock cell at(12.5,17.5), and works at(32.5,17.5). The longest sample doorway/gangplank traversal is20ft; no crew station blocks it. Launch-frame note: the vessel-local x0–20,y0–30 berth frame is not the same orientation as the dock footprint. At launch use xLaunch=30−yVessel, yLaunch=xVessel, z unchanged for every interior and fitting position; do not duplicate or mirror the airlock or stations.

### Powered movement

Powered speed10miles per actual travel hour. In initiative one coordinated vessel event per numbered round, after one actual pilotAction and one actual engineerAction from distinct capable trained operators at their real stations; that event may move up to90ft horizontal/vertical or hold position. No native vehicle turn or controller-swap extra movement. Ordinary sustained travel occupies both crew in their roles; they do not simultaneously rest, salvage or perform other Action work. Use supportStates for absent crew, fuel failure, docking and canopy transitions. An extra Action does not create another vessel event.

### Role instruction

Any willing character can learn this vessel’s pilot or engineer procedure from the corresponding living crew member in1uninterrupted active hour at the working docked station. Choose one role per instruction. It grants only ability to operate this exact model under its printed procedure, no general skill proficiency, vehicle ownership or instant mid-flight instruction. Training is not halved byTransition.

### Fuel supply and refilling

Installed tank begins with600powered minutes of fuel,30lb; each powered minute burns0.05lb, with fractional seconds and fuel retained exactly. Dry tank hardware is already in dry hull mass. Dock stock is one refill canister of300minutes:15lb fuel plus5lb reusable empty container,20lb gross. It is not aboard unless physically loaded, when its gross weight/Load count. Refilling while safely grounded or securely moored takes10active minutes and real supply; capacity600minutes, transfer only the amount that fits, leaving the exact remainder in its actual container. It cannot be done in unsupported flight/canopy descent. Every elapsed powered second spends1/60minute, including docking, hovering, deployment preparation and powered-idle mooring. Zero fuel immediately removes powered lift, not just forward motion; determine actual remaining support. Baseline voyage t0 is actual engine/fuel activation at the start of takeoff. If the engine is run before takeoff, every such powered second is consumed; cancellation does not refund it.

### Cabin air and cartridge replacement

One installed20lb cartridge supplies12elapsed hours of protected cabin and sealed-airlock air from first activation forup to6breathing occupants. The cartridge remains20lb when spent; its contents are a retained chemical/rebreather medium. The clock runs through opening, breached seals, empty cabins and engine-off mooring. Airlock purging uses this same finite running cartridge and does not reset it or add time. One20lb replacement cartridge remains at dock; safely supported, unoccupied installation takes30minutes, with the old cartridge retained or actually removed. No fuel or air recharge is created by closing a door or returning to ground. Baseline voyage t0 is the actual cartridge activation at the start of takeoff. If activated earlier, every earlier elapsed second is consumed even if departure is canceled.

### Exposure and recovery

NEW local encounter hazard above10000ft: nonmagical upper-atmosphere inhalation exposure, with a cold-inhalation damage component and a thin-air environmental-fatigue component. The errant equation causes melody loss, not this air hazard. These classifications and the following source-interface completions are proposed authorship requiring GPT review; they are not recovered climate rules or real atmospheric simulation. An unprotected breathing creature tracks actual cumulative exposure. At each completed60unprotected seconds, make one CONsaveDC15 for the event: failure3d6cold and oneExhaustion from the thin-air component; successhalfcold and noExhaustion. Roll cold damage once for this recipient/event and apply its actual save result, defenses and life rules. Partial exposure carries across short protected intervals; one uninterrupted protected minute clears only its incomplete remainder, not prior damage or Exhaustion. Actual no-breath permission, working cabin/airlock protection or an active compatible hood prevents this complete local inhalation event while effective. It grants no immunity to independent external cold, pressure, falling or other hazards. Partial defenses do not stop the exposure clock or cancel an already resolved event. No second unnamed suffocation track or arbitrary breath-holding timer is imported; the source corpus does not supply that missing full procedure in this review.

### Hull breaches

At hull60HP or less cabin seal fails; an engineerAction at the actual station plus one patchpad restores it if hull remainsabove0. A sealed pad is consumed even if later breached. A new crossing fromabove60 to60orless breaks it again; continued damage while already≤60 does not repeatedly undo a repair unless a single hitdeals20or more post-defense hull damage. Stock4patchpads aboard. Hullat0 loses allpowered movement and airseal; no HP or stock restoration by repair ritual without real work.

### Canopy limits

One reusable gravity canopy,AC12HP20, is fixed to the hull. It requires hull>0 to support the craft. Use the actual pilot deployment Action and support transfer above. Record deployedAt at completion; first300ft descent step is6seconds later, then fixed6second steps until actual legal supporting ground. Full hull clearance/support are mandatory. A pilotAction sets up to30ft lateral displacement for the next step; a later setting replaces it, never adds movement or resets the deadline. No pilot is needed for straight downward steps. Deployment while already deployed does not reset anything. Canopy retraction is permitted only while actually grounded or securely moored, takes one pilotAction, and gives no movement. Powered flight cannot cancel/restart canopy deadlines in midair. Canopy0HP or unsupported hull0HP ends that support and starts actual ordinary Falling. A legal deployment during an existing fall may arrest it only if completed before the relevant impact and all actual conditions hold; it never erases a resolved impact. This controlled machinery remains NEW local authorship, not the general Falling rule.

### Actual hood use

Six actual2lb breathhoods begin in the loose-kit locker and count toward payload. One Action dons/activates a hood on a willing self or willing/unconscious adjacent compatible creature. It provides60elapsed minutes of protection from this printed highAtmosphere hazard, one activation only; swapping/removing does not pause or reset the timestamp. A replacement hood has its own real stock and activation Action. Spent/removed hoods remain physical cargo. There is no free incompatible-anatomy adaptation, flight, impact protection, cabin repair or added air-cartridge time.

### Repairs

While safely landed, one proficient Engineeringworker with actual tool,4active hours and50gp actual material restores30hullHP up to120. Requires hullabove0 and all major members present. One actual materiallot aboard covers one repair; other stock requires real acquisition. This ordinary active repairwork may receiveTransition under its exact workOrder/qualification rules. It never restoresfuel/air/hoods/pads/canopy. Canopyabove0 may regain10HP fromoneactivehour,10gp material and actual tool; stock10gp aboard forone such repair. ### Launch orientation

NEW safe launch dock x0–60,y0–40,z0. In launch coordinates Margin Kite occupies x0–30,y0–20. Its vessel-local berth/interior frame remains x0–20,y0–30 and is physically quarter-turned into the launch footprint by xLaunch = 30 − yVessel, yLaunch = xVessel, zLaunch = zVessel. This is a rotation plus translation, not a mirror. Apply it to hull, crew, stations, doors, airlock, lockers and fittings consistently. Thus the vessel-local main cabin x0–20,y0–15 maps to launch x15–30,y0–20; vessel-local airlock x10–20,y15–25 maps to launch x5–15,y10–20; inner door yVessel=15,xVessel=10–20 maps along xLaunch=15,yLaunch=10–20; outer door xVessel=20,yVessel=15–25 maps along yLaunch=20,xLaunch=5–15; pilot station xVessel0–5,yVessel0–5 maps launch x25–30,y0–5; engineer station xVessel15–20,yVessel0–5 maps launch x25–30,y15–20. Supply cage x35–50,y0–15 contains the one dock refill canister and one replacement air cartridge; neither is aboard until physically loaded. Public staging x0–60,y20–40 keeps a clear 10-ft route to the hull. Ground support is ordinary and continuous while the full hull footprint remains on the dock.

Nima Voss begins in the transformed pilot-station footprint x25–30,y0–5; Pell Rusk begins in the transformed engineer-station footprint x25–30,y15–20. Passengers and loose cargo must be placed within transformed legal cabin/locker footprints before takeoff.

Declining before activating the installed fuel/air equipment consumes no fuel, no air and earns no wage. Once the air cartridge or engine/fuel system is actually activated, its real clock runs even if takeoff is delayed or canceled. Wage entitlement begins only when the sortie actually completes takeoff. The baseline plan activates fuel and cabin air at t0, the start of the separate six-second coordinated takeoff. Earlier activation or preflight engine running adds its real elapsed/powered cost and does not move the wage trigger.

### Airlock — Geometry

One10x10x12ft chamber, an inner10ft door to the main cabin and an outer10ft door to the gangplank. Each door/valve can be operated from either side of that door; the outer door also has an ordinary control at the cabin service station. Each opening/closing is an Action. Both start closed; working protection is initially present when cabin air is active. Door bodies AC15HP20 each, no attacks or autonomous movement.

### Airlock — Interlock

Opening one door normally requires the other closed. The inner door additionally requires protected airlock status. Forcing a door open or destroying it defeats that physical interlock and creates its real breach; it does not magically preserve cabin protection.

### Airlock — Outside cycle

Open inner, move using actual legal movement into airlock, close inner, open outer, move to the gangplank/deck, then close outer. Actions and movement may share a normal6second interval only when the actor has those actual budgets and sufficient Speed. Main cabin stays protected while inner remains closed. The airlock becomes unprotected when outer opens; people beyond it are exposed according to actual protection.

### Airlock — Purge

When both intact doors are closed and the hull seal and running cartridge work, begin60uninterrupted elapsed seconds to restore airlock protection. Opening a door restarts an unfinished purge. These are machinery/observation seconds, not Transition work. Protection begins on completion before a same-instant exposure or hood-expiry evaluation. Closing a door does not repair a hull breach or regenerate the cartridge.

### Airlock — Return cycle

Open outer, move physically into airlock, close outer, wait the actual60second purge, open inner and move into cabin, then close inner. Bodies must fit fully; no entry through occupied cells or solids. Actual no-breath/other protective abilities retain their printed scope. If the inner door is forced open while the chamber is unsafe, cabin protection is lost until both doors are repaired/closed, hull breaches patched and an actual60second purge completes. Air charge continues throughout.

### Airlock — Protection boundary

At a completed safe closure/purge or existing-source protection expiration use the actual timestamp. An unprotected minute accumulated before protection is restored still produces its due save; the restoration prevents only later exposure. A hazard event exactly at restoration is avoided under the explicit completion-first order. A hood expiring during purge leaves its wearer exposed until protection really returns.

### Support — Priority

At a common timestamp finish an otherwise legal support-transfer/door operation first only if all its actual prerequisites remain available through completion. Then resolve resource expiry and unmet control requirements, then ordinary Falling deadlines. A transfer cannot finish after its supporting hull or required mechanism has already been destroyed. No later Action retroactively avoids an impact. Exactly enough fuel to cover an interval supplies power through that interval’s endpoint, allowing its legal completed transfer to resolve before the resulting zero-fuel loss. Insufficient fuel removes lift at its actual earlier depletion timestamp; the transfer cannot pretend it remained powered.

### Support — Grounded

Actual full legal supporting footprint holds the vessel. Engine may be off. Engine activation and takeoff require fuel, intact hull, trained distinct operators and one coordinated 6-second pilot/engineer event outside initiative; it is the one vessel event for that round and includes only takeoff, not any extra travel. Baseline t0 is activation at the start of this event. At t=6 seconds takeoff is complete and outbound travel begins. If departure is canceled after activation but before completion, real fuel/air clocks already spent remain spent and no wage is earned because takeoff did not complete.

### Support — Powered

Fuel>0 and hull>0 are necessary. While in initiative, both operators must contribute to the one coordinated event each numbered round. The previously established powered hold lasts to that round end; if either contribution is still missing then, support ends and ordinary Falling begins at that actual boundary. Fuel0 or hull0 removes powered lift immediately. Contributions already paid are not erased merely because the actor becomes unable afterward, but a later round requires new actual contributions. Outside initiative, interrupted sustained crew work enters initiative/actual six-second intervals without granting a new free period.

### Support — Moored

At the marked berth, both operators spend their coordinated event attaching the one cleat assembly. Outside initiative they work concurrently for6seconds. Once completed, actual intact lattice/cleat support bears the entire craft; choose engine-off or powered idle. No continuing crew Actions are required merely to remain physically moored. Before transfer, verify combined deck-and-mooring load≤6000lb. At overload or actual support destruction the cleat releases/fails and unsupported loads enter ordinary Falling; a separately valid active support retains only its actual scope. Crossing the rating is not silently forbidden after the fact.

### Support — Departure

Once the worker, case and all intended cargo are actually aboard, the airlock has completed its cycle and both operators are at stations, spend one coordinated6second event to start/hold the engine and unmoor. It consumes0.1powered minute and grants no horizontal travel in addition. The next travel leg starts after this event. If a prerequisite fails, remain moored; no free unsupported transition.

### Support — Canopy

A trained pilot at the actual station spends one Action to deploy. During a normal powered deployment, the NEW governor holds the existing position for these6seconds, consumes actual fuel and requires intact hull; the command must finish to provide canopy support. On completion the engine switches off and the fixed canopy schedule begins. This deployment is the vessel event for that round. Fuel/hull loss before completion causes an actual fall until a legal completed deployment or other support takes effect.

### Support — Falling

Without an actual valid support, start ordinary Falling using the existing marker/impact procedure. No immediate extra drop, free pause, rebased marker or automatic recovery is added by the vessel. Occupants follow the current carrier/body rules; a detached falling creature has its own actual support history.

### Strand work and interruption

Phase1 begins on actual arrival at the marked mooring point and lasts20elapsed minutes. The two crew complete the mooring event, and a worker sets3–1–4 with three Actions within that interval, using actual airlock, movement and protection. If requirements remain incomplete at its end, complete them and then restart a full20minute alignment. Wrong order deals the existing one3d6psychic/WIS15half pulse and invalidates alignment. A worker without the score may instead use the printed30minute INT(Investigation)DC15 study before a new complete alignment. Phase2 follows successful alignment: one actual tool user with usable hands, the real three clamps and10active minutes; following the supplied procedure requires no extra unprinted proficiency or roll. Phase3 then takes30active minutes with actual insulated tongs and the lined case; release and final packing complete together at its end. Clamps remain attached through release and require three subsequent Actions to unfasten/recover. Tongs may be secured in the worker’s existing kit during the final packing work. Phase2 interruption loses that unfinished phase. Phase3 interruption retains completed10minute blocks only. The worker may deliberately change protection between phases without losing completed work; the Action takes real time. SCOPED NEW completion accepted for this candidate: Phase2+3 constitute one named complex-salvage workOrderId for the existing Transition motif only. At motif preflight fix the real strand, the same mandatory worker, the three clamps, tongs, lined case and beneficiary. If a lawful Transition benefit is actually granted and that worker starts within its source window, Phase2 active work becomes 5 minutes and Phase3 active work becomes 15 minutes under the existing ceil-half rule. Phase1 alignment/observation, study, travel, crew events, Actions, airlock purge, hood duration and all other clocks are ineligible. The benefit cannot transfer to a retry/new worker/new strand. This authors only this work order; it does not modify EPI01–07 globally.

Three actual50ft harness/line assemblies can anchor at fixed hull cleats, each supporting at most600lb of actual attached load. Clip/unclip each is an Action; line geometry must fit actual hull/deck positions. They prevent only a fall that the real intact line, fitted harness and anchor can hold; no automatic teleport, hauled movement or immunity to unrelated impact. An unsupported or over-capacity load uses current Falling rules. A retained hanging person needs actual movement or hauling to regain support. Before departing, recover or deliberately abandon each real line and its custody; no duplicate ship stock.

### Carrying during the sample

At most40lb personal gear plus5lb harness,4lb from two hoods,6lb clamps,1lb tongs and12lb loaded case=68lb on the sample worker; it fits STR10/Medium150lb physical capacity, but actual item Loads and access must also fit its10Load capacity. With only these stated weight-only items the carriedLoad is6.8; it is Burdened, so actual Speed becomes20, which still covers each printed doorway/gangplank route within its6second interval. A slower or differently loaded real character must recalculate movement, not use the sample timestamp.

## Wages and reward

## Starting the annual term
The term starts only when all three are complete:
1. the clauses are explained in a form the claimant actually understands;
2. the claimant signs or makes an understood witnessed mark;
3. the claimant transfers an actual **50 gp bond** into the real lockbox;
4. the claimant has actual access to the three readable plates.

Record that completion timestamp as **T0**. If any prerequisite is missing, the term has not begun.

## Annual contradiction record
Aethel's civil year is **400 elapsed 24-hour days**.

Record 1 opens at T0 and is due at T0+400 days. Record n opens at T0+(n−1)×400 days and is due at T0+n×400 days.

A qualifying annual statement identifies:
- two mutually incompatible fictional claims;
- one actually observed record supporting each;
- one concrete question that could reconcile them.

Honest uncertainty is allowed. A real-player secret or belief is never required.

A statement may be submitted after its record opens. Future unopened years cannot be prepaid.

### Delivery and review
Use the functioning panel slot or dictate to an actually available Veyr. Record the annual number, completion time, channel, contents, and custody.

Veyr reviews within 24 elapsed hours of actual receipt. A timely filing stays protected while legitimate review or notice is pending.

The first actual rejection notice for a record creates one **10-day correction interval**. Later rejections do not restart it. Early rejection never shortens the original annual due date.

If neither delivery channel can actually receive a filing at the deadline, a real timely documented attempt with the actual statement can protect that record. Each annual record needs its own statement/attempt.

## Ending participation
Before termination, the claimant is told whether the bond settlement is refund or forfeiture.

A refund requires:
- at least one accepted annual record; and
- every record whose **original due timestamp is at or before the exit time** to be accepted.

A record that has merely opened but is not yet due is not accelerated for exit.

If refund eligibility is not met, the claimant may remain active while completing the real record/review or may knowingly leave immediately and forfeit the original 50 gp bond.

Default ends the term and forfeits only that original bond. It creates no soul claim, curse, class change, forced Oath breach, or extra fee.

Actual true death also ends future obligations and applies the same bond-refund test. Being Downed, unconscious, or an Undead-ancestry character is not by itself true death.

## Complete patent offer and annual term

The term requires actual understanding, signature or witnessed mark, the actual bond and actual readable plate access. The following are the complete material offer terms; no hidden additional clause is implied.

### Issuer

Veyr of the Second Margin, Mephistopheles’ envoy for this Canian offer and licensed courier for the Canian engine patent office. This grants only the printed local powers and no authority beyond the owner-corrected Cania scope.

### Offer

the named claimant is designated heir to the three NEW CF-series Canian engine patents. Actual benefits are the reserved readable plate set, this office’s recognition, the printed appointment/access privileges and the disclosed technical knowledge. Copies may be shared as stated in knowledgeReward. There is no grant of ancestry, soul ownership, class proficiency, global engine control or unrelated estate. The original hook establishes patents and knowledge; these detailed rights and procedures are NEW local proposals.

### Starting the term

first explain all clauses in a form the claimant actually understands. A signature or understood witnessed mark, the actual50gp deposit, and actual access to the three readable plates must all be complete. Record T0 at that completion. No term begins while any is missing. The one finite paper copy set is physically supplied; already obtained readable copies can serve only if actually present and explicitly accepted by both sides. No stock respawns on a later offer.

### Annual records

record1 opens atT0 and is due atT0+400elapsed24hour days. Recordn opens atT0+(n−1)×400days and is due atT0+n×400days while the term remains active. A statement can be submitted early after its record opens. Future unopened records cannot be prepaid. Each record is separate; accepting, reviewing, rejecting or delaying one never rebases another due date. These are Aethel civil years, not Descent rotations or primordial Cycles.

### Statement

identify two mutually incompatible fictional claims, one actual observed record supporting each and one concrete question that could reconcile them. Honest uncertainty is allowed. No real-player secret or belief is required. Invented evidence and the same accepted claim/evidence pair reused for a later year do not qualify; materially new conflicting evidence can qualify if identified. The printed teaching examples show the form and are not free evidence that the claimant observed.

### Delivery

complete a real deposit of the written statement in the functioning panel slot, or complete dictation to an actually available Veyr. Mark its annual number; if omitted, assign it to the earliest opened, unaccepted record. A physical delivery may contain several separately identified statements, each with its own real evidence. Record completion time, channel, contents and actual custody. A known completed filing is not erased by later paper theft or a damaged drawer; keep the session record and an actual copy or reconstruction for review. A blank promise to write something later is not a statement.

### Review

an available Veyr reviews within24elapsed hours of actual receipt. If a functioning slot receives a timely filing while Veyr is absent, that filing is already timely; review begins on actual restored availability. A timely submitted statement or correction remains pending, rather than defaulted, while its legitimate review or required actual notice is outstanding. Rejection must identify all known missing, fabricated, duplicated or nonconflicting fields. Unknown truth or disagreement with a character’s belief is not itself a rejection ground. An objectively erroneous rejection has no operative penalty and must be corrected against these printed criteria.

### Correction deadline

the first actual rejection notice for a record creates one10day correction interval. Its final delivery deadline is the latest of the original due date, that first-notice-plus10days, and any genuine availability extension. Later rejections do not restart the10days. Early rejection never makes the original annual deadline earlier. Complete correction exactly at the deadline counts. If it then awaits review, default waits for that review; if the correction is rejected after the fixed deadline, default occurs at the actual valid rejection notice, not retroactively. If no filing, correction or protected attempt is pending at a reached final deadline, that record defaults then.

### Unavailable channels

if neither the panel nor Veyr can actually receive a statement at the relevant deadline, make a real timely documented delivery attempt and retain the actual statement. When a channel becomes usable again and the claimant actually receives notice of that availability, the held record has10days to complete delivery. This is a delivery extension for that record, not a new year. If several annual deadlines passed during genuine unavailability, each requires its own timely attempted statement. A paper already deposited in a functioning slot needs review, not a second delivery extension. A second actual outage can extend a record only with another real timely attempt against its then-current deadline.

### Ending participation

before completing a voluntary termination, state whether its settlement is refund or forfeiture under the printed rule. A refund requires at least one accepted annual record and every record whose original due timestamp is at or before termination to be accepted. A newly opened but not-yet-due record is not demanded for exit. If the refund condition is not met, the claimant may remain active while completing the actual required work/review, or knowingly end immediately by forfeiting the original50gp bond. A mere request to learn the refund status is not itself consent to forfeiture. Actual termination ends future record openings, title and bench permission, but not retained knowledge, paper, soul, memory, HP or class abilities.

### Termination notice

give an understood declaration directly to Veyr or complete deposit of a signed notice in the actual functioning panel. If both channels are genuinely unavailable, retain a dated signed notice and record a real delivery attempt with an actual witness or existing delivery record; that completed attempt can terminate the term under the same disclosed settlement rule. No fictional offscreen delivery is assumed. An invalid forged notice or another person’s unilateral signature cannot end the claimant’s term.

### Default and death

one valid default ends the term and forfeits only the original50gp bond; no soul claim, curse, class change, automatic Paladin Oath breach or extra penalty is created. Actual true death also ends future annual obligations, applying the same refund-eligibility test at that timestamp to the original bond for the actual estate or designated recipient. Merely being Downed, unconscious or an active Undead-ancestry character is not true death. Later restoration does not restart the ended term. Record an unpaid legitimate refund until an actual authorized recipient can receive actual funds.

### Settlement

return or forfeit only the original actual50gp once. If it was stolen or is otherwise unavailable, a refund can remain an unpaid ordinary claim; no coins appear and no annual obligation continues merely because the issuer has not paid. Amounts from that original deposit already returned to or physically recovered by the claimant are credited against its refund, not paid twice. If the claimant took the original bond before a later forfeiture, the issuer has at most the property claim to those same50gp, not another50gp penalty. All custody and ordinary consequences remain real.

### Refusal and amendment

refusal creates no term and may lead to the separate free-will exercise, which can also be declined. Its ACCEPT slip is not a contract signature or deposit. Silence, coercion, incapacity or deception about the terms cannot create informed acceptance. An amendment needs a complete visible mutually understood document and actual agreement before effect; no silent retrospective deadline change or replenished stock. Preserve old and new records.

## Complete CF-pattern operating instructions

### CF-1 Isolation

diagram labels I (inlet), E (exhaust), V (vent), C (inspection cap), the pressure gauge and the cell socket. Close I, close E and open V, each an Action. If pressure was above zero, keep V open for sixty elapsed seconds; its calibrated gauge then reaches zero. Only then open C with an Action. A cold shell is not evidence of zero pressure. Closing V before the sixty seconds complete retains pressure and requires a new complete vent interval. There is no pressure refill without a real powered charge. At an already verified zero gauge, the sixty-second wait is unnecessary.

### CF-2 External Cooling Loop

diagram traces supply through port 2, the external return through port 1, then the bypass at port 3. At verified zero pressure, set those three indexed valves in order 2, 1, 3, one Action each. Labels mark the flow direction, not a universal code for every engine. During a sealed powered test, the blue return vane must turn continuously for sixty elapsed seconds. A stationary vane with pressure present identifies blocked or reversed routing, rather than proof that the machine lacks power. A leak instead prevents the pressure gauge holding at 1. These are distinguishable observations.

### CF-3 Pressure Seal

diagram shows the keyed 2-inch seat and the intact ring profile. At verified zero pressure with C open, two active minutes with the actual hand tool remove the old ring, inspect the seat, fit one actual compatible 0.2 lb replacement and tighten the retainer. Keep the old ring as scrap. Close C, close V and insert/activate one actual cold cell, each an Action. A sealed test must hold gauge 1 with the blue return vane moving for sixty elapsed seconds. A split ring cannot be repaired by tightening harder; a damaged seat needs separately sourced parts/work. Never install a ring under pressure.

### Appointments and diagnosis

A claimant with an active term may book one ten-minute instructor-led service appointment per actual 24 hours with an available Veyr. It teaches the three diagrams and services this press, with actual controls, parts and test time included. Reading the complete plates or doing later self-directed work has no artificial daily reset, but needs real access, time, tools, materials and any actual qualifications. Following the posted accessible steps succeeds without a roll. Investigating an unrecognized fault instead takes ten active minutes and INT (Engineering) DC 15; failure spends that time and reveals no false diagnosis. It does not consume a cold cell unless the actor actually starts a powered test. A teaching appointment is instruction, not Transition-eligible crafting; a separate ordinary qualified repair’s active tool-work uses existing work-order rules, and never halves Actions or mandatory elapsed pressure/flow observations.

### Cell activation and stored pressure

Each actual cell activation consumes that one cell’s use immediately, successful or not, supplies at most ten elapsed minutes of drive and can pressurize the sealed chamber only once. Record activatedAt and chargeSpent. Venting or a discharge empties that one charge; closing the vent does not recharge it. Its casing remains. After ten minutes the drive ends; any retained pressure must still be vented before opening. Loading a second cell is a new real activation, not a reset of the first. Activation requires the actual cap closed, vent closed and gauge verified at zero. An attempted activation without those prerequisites fails without consuming or resetting a cell; use ordinary Actions and the visible interlock. An intact seal raises gauge to 1. A cracked seal lets that one charge escape and the gauge reaches 0 by the failed sixty-second test. The running drive cannot refill pressure. A wrong route with an intact seal instead leaves gauge 1 with the return vane stopped. Both faults can coexist; the leaking gauge then reaches 0 and the operator must correct both before a passing test. Venting, discharge or pressure loss sets pressReady=false. Drive time does not recreate gauge1 after that one pressure charge is spent.

### Safe service

With the initial zero gauge, close/verify I and E, open/verify V and open C using their actual Actions; set 2→1→3; replace the cracked seal with two minutes of actual tool work; close C, close V, activate one real cell; observe sixty elapsed seconds. The ten-minute teaching appointment has enough time for these steps and explanation. If time is interrupted or prerequisites fail, record actual completed steps, remaining stock and pressure; incomplete teaching grants no fabricated completion record. Opening C, changing tested routing/valves, removing or changing the fitted seal, or otherwise breaking the tested configuration invalidates any existing pressReady state before service begins.

### Failure

A cracked seal or wrong route fails the sixty-second test: no ready indicator and the platen remains mechanically blocked. The actual activated cell is still spent; no paper or ink is used until a real print. Opening C or trying to replace a seal while gauge>0 releases that one stored charge: all creatures within 5 ft make DEX save DC 15, taking 3d6 force on failure or half on success, with ordinary defenses/life rules. Pressure then becomes 0 and that charge cannot blast again. The engraved warning makes this foreseeable. Destruction releases stored pressure once by the same rule, if any remains; inert wreckage does not repeat it.

### Printing

Printing requires pressReady=true at the moment of the print Action, the same live drive/current pressure charge that passed the current test, an actual blank sheet and at least one ink impression. One Action per sheet prints one selected engraved diagram, consuming one sheet and one ink impression. A three-plate set needs three actual sheets and three Actions. The starting stock supports at most two new complete sets in total. If readiness becomes invalid between print Actions, further printing is blocked until actual safe service, a new real cell activation and a new successful 60-second test restore pressReady; already printed sheets and already spent stock remain as they are. Failed tests do not delete paper.

### Using the learned procedures

The plates teach an actual safe isolation sequence, how to distinguish loss of pressure from failed coolant circulation, and a keyed-seal maintenance process. They can guide ordinary handling of a demonstrated compatible CF-pattern device. For another machine, first establish its real port mapping, pressure limits, materials, actual parts and operating procedure; a shared word such as engine does not establish compatibility. Apply the existing research/repair rules to genuinely new engineering. Nothing grants a free research qualification mark or promotes a pending crafting recipe.

### Current press readiness

NEW scoped local machine completion. Track pressReady as a current state, never as a historical achievement. pressReady=true only while all are simultaneously true: press structure is intact and supported; service cap C closed; vent V closed; inlet/exhaust and the 2→1→3 route remain in the tested correct configuration; functioning fitted seal is still intact; gauge=1 from the same unspent stored pressure charge created by the current actual cell activation; that same cell drive is still live; and a successful uninterrupted current 60-second test has completed after the last readiness-invalidating change. Printing additionally requires an actual blank sheet and remaining ink impression. A prior successful test does not authorize printing after pressure is vented or discharged, after C is opened, after the seal is removed/lost/damaged, after routing or relevant valves change, after gauge falls to0, after the active drive expires, or after press support/structure is lost. Any such event sets pressReady=false. Safe service may repair/correct the cause, but a new actual legal activation and new 60-second test are required; this never replenishes cells, pressure charges, paper, ink, seals or prior prints.

## Refusal and the free-will scene

playerExactEdits.old: If the physical copy set does not yet exist, allocation does not create it. The press must actually make it from remaining stock.
playerExactEdits.replacement: Allocation is an entitlement to the first actual new set, not its immediate existence. If that set is not already printed, Veyr permits one instructor-led service appointment for the participants, independent of signing the patent term, using the real remaining press stock. Repair/test/printing takes its actual time and may fail. Deliver the first complete set once according to the accepted allocation; a partial set stays in actual custody until completed. If it cannot be made, record the unfulfilled allocation and options to find real materials or relinquish it. No second payment, imaginary paper or automatic engine repair follows. The second possible new set remains office stock unless actually allocated separately. This instructor-led service appointment is an actual refusal-path access grant and does not require an active annual patent contract or claimant bench privilege.
